claims.claim_text: The indexed Franz L. Alt is identified with high confidence as Franz Leopold Alt, the mathematician whose institutional biography and Army identity card document his second-lieutenant rank.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional biography reproduces Alt's Army identity card and describes his promotion to second lieutenant.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: the rare exact first name, surname, middle initial, wartime period, Army status, and second-lieutenant rank agree.
claims.temporal_assessment: The biography dates his Army service to 1943-1945 but does not itself establish when or whether he entered an OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: Franz Leopold Alt is retained as a documented full-name variant. The identity source is not used to invent an OSS assignment or immediate predecessor affiliation.

claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly bounded: institute employment began in 1938 and continued until the 1943 Army draft, then resumed after military service.
claims.match_notes: Published as last civilian employer before military service, not as the immediate affiliation before OSS. The source does not specify Alt's pre-draft job title.
